title: fix(plugin-auth)!: import-users joins each row to the administrator's current organization in multi-org mode
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9L2v7Go4wB2qdBSjScAixcm)_

Fixes #34535

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the admin import-users route (`git grep -n import-users -- skills/` answers 0 lines on this head); the route is documented in `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`, updated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多组织模式下，CSV/JSON 批量导入用户时，每一行的用户都在建号的同一个事务里加入管理员当前所在的组织（和单个新建同一个判断、同一个加入函数）；名额满等原因加入被拒的那一行不建号、不给临时密码、不发邀请，在该行报错，其余行照常；没有当前组织时整单 400 `NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION`，和单个新建同码同句。upsert 匹配到的已有用户也按同一规矩加入。
- 为什么改：你在 #34535 裁 B「入当前组织，被拒行不建号」。以前多组织下导入的用户不属于任何组织，`positions` 列每行都被成员资格校验拒掉，托管版用一份 CSV 建带岗位的员工走不通。
- 风险与回滚：属收窄（BREAKING）。四处答复变了：无当前组织整单 400（含 dryRun）；服务器跑不了加入时整单 501；被拒行不再建号；upsert 匹配到的已有用户加入被拒时连资料更新一起回滚。单组织模式不变（有 CONTROL 钉）。回滚＝revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`（`inRowUnit` 与 createData/updateData 两处）、`admin-user-endpoints.ts`（抽出的 `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin`，create-user 码句不变）、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`（真引擎 I1/I2）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 5/5 绿：I1 前两行进当前组织、第三行因名额上限失败且库里没有这个用户；I2 无当前组织 400。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Maintainer ruling 6942842013 on #34535 (option B, `Ruled: B`): in multi-org mode `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` follows create-user's ADR-0093 D3 amendment rule, row by row.

- **One settlement, shared.** create-user's pre-creation settlement (multi-org predicate, the caller's current organization, the unit-of-work seam and better-auth's `addMember`) moves into `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` in `admin-user-endpoints.ts`; create-user calls it with its codes and sentences byte-identical (its existing multi-org suite is unchanged and green), and import-users calls the same function. No copy.
- **Settled before any row is written, dry run included.** No current organization ⇒ the whole import answers `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION`; no unit of work or no organization plugin ⇒ `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`. Nothing is created.
- **One unit of work per row** (`inRowUnit`): a created row's `createUser` and `joinCurrentOrganization` run inside `createGrant.runAtomically` (the engine transaction; better-auth's adapter writes join it as an ambient transaction, ADR-0067 D2). A refused join throws out of the unit, the account rolls back, and the row fails with the vendor's code and create-user's sentence. The temporary password and the invitation target are recorded only after the unit committed, and invitations go out after `runImport`, so a refused row gets neither.
- **Matched existing users (upsert) join too**, per the seat's reading in 6942842013: the profile update and the join are one unit, so a refused join fails the row and leaves the profile as it was. `joinCurrentOrganization` gains an optional `account: 'created' | 'existing'` argument so that refusal does not say "no user was created", and an existing member is reported `membershipCreated: false`; create-user passes nothing and is unchanged.
- **Wiring:** the import route now passes `getTenancy` and `getCallerActiveOrganizationId` (create-user's session reader) in `auth-plugin.ts`.
- **Audit:** the run-level `user.import_run` row records the joined `organizationId` in multi-org mode.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` Bulk Import section states the rule.
- Single-org mode (and a degraded wall) does not move: no join, the reconciler binds the default organization.

## Tests

- `admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts` — the file's shared table-backed harness gains a multi-org mode (a unit of work that really restores the tables on throw, a member cap refused with better-auth's code, and the grant-holder membership refusal on position assignment), and one new top-level describe with 10 cases: joins + positions validate; refused row rolled back with no invitation (`invite`) and no password (`temporary`); 400 whole, dry run too, asserted equal to create-user's settlement answer; 501 for no unit of work / no `addMember`; dry run joins nothing; upsert joins and skips an existing member; upsert refusal rolls the profile back; CONTROL single-org.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts` — the existing real-route, real-walled-posture harness for create-user's join gains I1 (three rows under `OS_ORG_MEMBERSHIP_LIMIT=3`: two join the current organization, the third is refused and its account is gone from `sys_user`) and I2 (no current organization: 400, no user). This file is outside the claim's `plugin-auth` test paths; it is the existing harness for this exact join, so the pin went there (AGENTS.md: a new pin goes into the component's shared harness file).
- No existing test was changed to accommodate the fix.

## Acceptance notes

FROM → TO, measured (multi-org mode unless stated):

| Request | `main` answers | This PR answers |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Import, administrator has no current organization | `200`, every row created, in no organization (dogfood I2 on the pre-fix build: `created: 1`) | `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION`, create-user's sentence, nothing created |
| Same, `dryRun: true` | `200` preview | `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION` |
| Import on a host with no unit of work or no organization plugin | `200`, rows created | `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, create-user's sentence, nothing created |
| A row the organization refuses (member cap) | created, in no organization (dogfood I1 on the pre-fix build: `created: 3`) | row `failed` with the vendor's code, account rolled back, no temporary password, no invitation; other rows land |
| Upsert row matching an existing user | profile updated, no membership | profile updated and joined in one unit; a refused join fails the row and the profile is not updated |
| A created row that joins | created, in no organization; its `positions` refused on every row | created and a `member` of the current organization; its `positions` assign |
| Single-org mode, any of the above | unchanged | unchanged (CONTROL pin) |

- The three cells beyond the ruling's text (501 whole, dry run refused whole, upsert profile rolled back with a refused join) apply create-user's same rule; the area accepted them, and they are declared in the changeset's BREAKING list.
- ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — no schema key, export or stored row changes; the moved answers are admin HTTP refusals.
- ADR-0093 D3 amendment's closing sentence ("…every other creation path (self sign-up, bulk import, SSO JIT, host hooks), still binds nothing in multi mode") is now false for bulk import; the ADR bookkeeping is carded as #34809 (`docs/adr/**` is outside an implementing card's surface).
- A refused row's `rows[].code` is the vendor's code as `mapAuthApiError` reads it (`ORGANIZATION_MEMBERSHIP_LIMIT_REACHED` in the unit pin); the import response gains no new field.

## Verification

Final head `6bfc9758` (the only commit after `870ce227` is a one-line anchor fix in `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`).

<details><summary>Local gate round on 6bfc9758 — 108 / 108 exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 108 commands; each ran with stdin closed and its exit captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: `108 derived, 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. File: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/34535-gates-ran.txt`.
First round on `870ce227`: two non-zero, both fixed before this round — `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 (shallow clone: its pinned fixture commit fetched with `--no-tags`, then 48/48), and `check:doc-anchors` exit 1 (`#create-a-user` → `#create-a-user-directly`, the commit above).
</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` on `870ce227` (after merging `origin/main` `f6f5b50a` and a full `pnpm build`): Test Files 282 passed (282), Tests 5916 passed | 10 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0 after typing the harness's unit-of-work mock as the seam declares it.
- `create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`: 5/5 on the fix.
- Full dogfood battery, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock on `870ce227`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (42m07s), Test Files 478 passed | 3 skipped (481), Tests 4057 passed | 68 skipped (4125). The final head differs only in the docs line above, which no dogfood test reads.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour, restore proven by blob == HEAD)</summary>

- **No join at all** (the settlement replaced by `undefined`, i.e. `main`'s import): the new multi-org describe goes 8 failed | 2 passed — the two that stay green are the dry-run-joins-nothing case and the single-org CONTROL, which assert the absence of a join.
- **Join outside a unit of work** (`runAtomically` replaced by a pass-through): 4 failed | 6 passed — the refused-row rollback (invite), the temporary-password case, the upsert rollback, and the commit bookkeeping of the happy path.
- **FROM reading on the real engine**: the same "no join" mutation built into `plugin-auth/dist` (`ablation-dist-preflight`: marker present in 2 built files), dogfood file: I1 `expected 3 to be 2` (all three rows created, cap never reached), I2 `expected 200 to be 400` (one user created in no organization); J1/J2 and the posture guard stay green. Restore leg rebuilt, marker absent from all 20 built files, tree clean.
</details>
